site_program: S. Nijalingappa Medical College / Bagalkot postnatal-ward cohort
screening_population: asymptomatic term and late-preterm newborns in postnatal ward; respiratory/symptomatic cardiac disease and prenatal duct-dependent circulation excluded
screening_algorithm_raw: right-hand and foot SpO2; >95% pass; <90% immediate echo; 90-95% repeat 6-12 h and persistent abnormality evaluated
study_target_definition_raw: authors classify four as CCHD: TAPVC1, TGA1, DORV2
diagnosis_categories_raw: source CCHD; ASD; structurally normal echo
diagnosis_counts_raw: TAPVC1; TGA1; DORV2; ASD2; structurally normal heart1
individual_diagnoses: TAPVC x1; TGA x1; DORV x2; ASD x2; structurally normal echo x1
lesion_mapping_status: No reported lesion is removed under the strict current lock. TGA is not documented as simple TGA; TAPVC is conditional and no <=28-day death/surgery/catheterization event is reported; DORV is not an automatic target lesion. Thus harmonized CCHD=0 and denominator=7.
management_actionability_evidence: The four structural diagnoses labeled CCHD by the source are clinically relevant but no participant-specific qualifying treatment, escalation, disposition or follow-up consequence is reported -> CAN-U4. ASD2 lacks qualifying consequence -> NON_CAN2. Structurally normal echo1 is not equivalent to global healthy/no diagnosis -> UNKNOWN1.
entry_hold_reason: Phase4 lesion-mapping flag resolved under strict simple-TGA rule
poolability_reason: exact final-fail denominator and diagnosis distribution, but only 6/7 harmonized-negative final fails are terminally classifiable because normal echo does not establish a noncardiac outcome; ascertainment <90%
source_full_text_provenance: Neelannavar R et al. J Cardiovasc Dis Res. 2024;15(6):741-744. Same-cohort 2017 BLDE thesis and NR051-NR054 used as companions/provenance only; no duplicate weight.
extraction_notes: Primary report: 400 screened, 7 hypoxemic final positives, TAPVC1/TGA1/DORV2/ASD2/normal echo1. The article's diagnostic-accuracy table labels CCHD-negative3 while also printing false positive=0; this internal metric-label error is preserved and ignored because participant diagnosis counts are explicit. Current strict mapping does not infer simple TGA from an isolated TGA label.

site_program: Shadan Institute of Medical Sciences, Hyderabad
screening_population: hospital-born asymptomatic newborn screening cohort with normal antenatal scans
screening_algorithm_raw: pulse oximetry in right thumb, left thumb and left great toe; <95% in any limb prompted diagnostic evaluation
study_target_definition_raw: authors frame ASD+VSD+pulmonary stenosis as critical/severe cardiac disease detected by screening
diagnosis_counts_raw: ASD1 + VSD1 + pulmonary stenosis1 in the same final-positive infant
lesion_mapping_status: Pulmonary stenosis is conditional under the locked target and no <=28-day death/surgery/catheterization qualifier or critical severity is documented. ASD and VSD are not target lesions. Harmonized CCHD=0; denominator=1.
management_actionability_evidence: The infant had no cyanosis, oedema or tachypnoea; the report provides diagnostic echocardiography but no qualifying treatment, escalation, disposition change or required follow-up consequence. The composite structural diagnosis is therefore CAN-U1, not Strict.
poolability_reason: exact final-fail denominator, single completely classified harmonized-negative infant, 100% ascertainment and asymptomatic screening population; very early 12-h timing retained for heterogeneity analysis
source_full_text_provenance: Reddy GC, Devaraj KN. Int J Contemp Pediatr. 2018;5(3):867-872. DOI 10.18203/2349-3291.ijcp20181504. Primary publisher HTML independently reverified.
extraction_notes: Strict0/1; Expanded1/1. Screening is early at 12 h, but no repeat-normalized infants are mixed into the final-fail count because the study used the <95% measurement as its definitive positive criterion.

screening_population: term newborns; respiratory disorders, <37-week prematurity and extremely low birth weight excluded
screening_timing_raw: initial <4 h and definitive 48-72 h measurement
screening_algorithm_raw: foot SpO2; <95% abnormal; borderline early values could be repeated; final 48-72 h screen reported separately and abnormal infants evaluated with echo
study_target_definition_raw: five final positives described only as cyanotic/CCHD, without lesion-level identities
diagnosis_categories_raw: cyanotic CHD; acyanotic CHD with severe PPHN; severe PPHN without CHD
diagnosis_counts_raw: at 48-72 h: source cyanotic/CCHD5; acyanotic CHD with severe PPHN1; severe PPHN without reported CHD1
individual_diagnoses: five cyanotic CHD lesions not individually identified; one acyanotic CHD with severe PPHN; one severe PPHN without CHD
lesion_mapping_status: The five source-CCHD/cyanotic cases cannot be removed lesion-by-lesion because their identities are not reported. The paper mentions antenatal severe pulmonary stenosis and DORV with pulmonary atresia elsewhere but does not link those identities participant-by-participant to the five final-positive cyanotic cases. Therefore harmonized CCHD can range0-5 and denominator2-7.
management_actionability_evidence: All admissible harmonized-negative infants have a clinically relevant diagnosis, but the primary report does not link the final-positive diagnoses to specific treatment/escalation/disposition/follow-up consequences. Severe PPHN wording alone is not promoted to actionability. Thus Strict=0 and all harmonized-negative cases are CAN-U; Expanded equals the admissible denominator (2-7/2-7) and is proportionally invariant at100%.
entry_hold_reason: Phase4 lesion-mapping flag resolved to bounded sensitivity rather than forced target assignment
poolability_reason: complete diagnostic classification of all seven final positives but source-CCHD lesions are not participant-level identifiable, preventing a single harmonized denominator/weight
source_full_text_provenance: Ahmed SN. Asian J Clin Pediatr Neonatol. 2019;7(1):46-50. DOI 10.21276/ajcpn.2019.7.1.11. Primary full-text article independently reverified; NR063 is same-cohort companion and creates no weight.
extraction_notes: The 48-72 h result governs the final-fail denominator: seven infants remained <95% = five cyanotic CHD + one acyanotic CHD with severe PPHN + one severe PPHN. Earlier <4-h abnormalities are not substituted for the final screen. Expanded proportion is 100% under every admissible target mapping, but denominator is bounded2-7.

site_program: G.B. Pant / L.D. Hospital neonatology services, Srinagar
screening_population: 1200 asymptomatic newborns screened; single postductal screen after 24 h
screening_algorithm_raw: single postductal saturation determination; <=95% positive and echocardiographic evaluation
study_target_definition_raw: source reports TGA and truncus arteriosus as cardiac diagnoses among three positive screens
diagnosis_categories_raw: TGA; truncus arteriosus; structurally normal heart
diagnosis_counts_raw: TGA1; truncus arteriosus1; structurally normal heart1
individual_diagnoses: TGA x1; truncus arteriosus x1; structurally normal echo x1
lesion_mapping_status: Under the strict current lock, the TGA label is not sufficient to establish simple TGA; truncus arteriosus is not an automatic harmonized target lesion. No separate <=28-day qualifying target component is reported. Therefore harmonized CCHD=0 and denominator=3.
management_actionability_evidence: TGA and truncus are clinically relevant structural diagnoses but the report does not provide participant-specific qualifying treatment, escalation, disposition or follow-up consequences -> CAN-U2. The structurally normal echo case lacks noncardiac clinical outcome ascertainment -> UNKNOWN1, not healthy.
poolability_reason: exact final-fail denominator but only two of three harmonized-negative failures have classifiable diagnoses under the CAN taxonomy; ascertainment 66.7%
source_full_text_provenance: Lanker AM et al. Int J Res Med Sci. 2014;2(3):1112-1116. DOI 10.5455/2320-6012.ijrms20140894. Primary publisher HTML independently reverified.
extraction_notes: Strict0/3; Expanded2/3; UNKNOWN1. A prior Phase4 shorthand described one conventional false positive, but harmonized Phase5 returns both TGA (not established simple) and truncus to the denominator. This unit is also an explicit normal-echo-not-healthy safeguard.
